_comment: Example config for the memory system. Copy to memory-config.json and fill in your own paths. All values here are placeholders — replace with your own. Nothing in this file should ever contain real customer data, real secrets, or a real denylist.

your-project._note: Use 'strict' for any repo with customer-adjacent data. 'pattern' is a deliberate opt-out only for repos that provably carry none.

paths._note: denylist and allowlist are gitignored and generated from your own source of truth. They never ship in this repo, in any form.

graph._note: deep_mode_allowed is a policy constant, not a user toggle. The rebuild trigger refuses deep mode regardless of this value; this key documents intent.

cockpit._note: Loopback-only. The panel exposes only switches that are safe to flip. Deep mode and redaction-disable are not among them.
